| 77 | ## The base | Current LF77, exact original unit |
| 79 | ### Basque ordinary non-PE base, exemptions and rates | Current LF79, exact original unit |
| 81 | All three provinces removed **urban-property own-use/vacancy imputation** from 2026: art. 13.2(j) has no content, and the imputation base/accrual provisions are deleted. Therefore a nonresident individual's vacant or personally used Basque dwelling produces no 2026 imputed-income charge merely through ownership. Actual rent and sale gains remain taxable. A 2025 imputation filed during 2026 is a different accrual and still follows its old rule. CE's connecting factor does not itself create an imputation charge after the local charging rule is removed. (B/A/G arts. 13, 24, 27 and dated amendments; [Bizkaia FAQ 900007013](https://www.bizkaia.eus/ogasuna/faq/faq_detalle.asp?Idioma=CA&idregistro=900007013).) | Current LF81, exact original unit |
| 83 | For ordinary **work/rent/capital receipts**, start with gross income classified under local PIT and remove actual statutory exemptions. The general non-PE rule does not import the resident annual scale, personal/family credits, resident employment bonus or loss-pooling system. General rate is **24%**, or **19%** for qualifying EU/EEA residents with the required information-exchange condition. Dividends, interest and disposal gains use **19%** where taxable, regardless of the general-rate category. Apply an evidenced treaty exemption or lower applicable treaty cap; do not invent a treaty rate. (B/A/G arts. 14, 24–26.) | Current LF83, exact original unit |
| 85 | **EU/qualifying EEA expenses:** for an individual, deduct only the expenses actually permitted by the relevant local PIT provision and demonstrably directly and inseparably related to the Spanish receipt. For an entity use its corresponding local CIT expense provisions, with the same nexus proof. Ordinary nonqualifying third-country recipients use the enacted gross-income rule; the separate art. 24.2 non-PE activity provision permits its specified personnel/material/supply costs and is not a general landlord expense election. (B/A art. 24.6; G art. 24.5; ordinary third-country litigation or a specific ruling must not be silently turned into a universal statutory amendment.) | Current LF85, exact original unit |
| 87 | For **EU/qualifying EEA individual residential rent**, select the actual local PIT art. 32 category before calculating the base. The method below applies the incorporated provision; Bizkaia's current official 2026 landlord example independently confirms using the local bonus and limited expenses. The equivalent Álava/Gipuzkoa application is a direct statutory incorporation, not a separately published agency example: | Current LF87, exact original unit |
| 89 | - Ordinary LAU art. 2 residential letting: **30% of gross rent** bonus; Álava **35%** only for its qualifying DA 34 rural zone/nucleus. | Current LF89, exact original unit |
| 90 | - Specified Bizigune/ASAP/similar public programme: **70%** bonus and that category's financing-only expenses. | Current LF90, exact original unit |
| 91 | - Qualifying tense-market/reference-rent or voluntarily limited reference/public-intermediation-price letting: **70%**, requiring the actual statutory rent ceiling and supporting evidence. A tenant's nationality or an ordinary lease alone does not establish this category. | Current LF91, exact original unit |
| 92 | - Other dwelling category outside the above, without business activity in the dwelling: **20%** bonus and that category's financing-only expenses. | Current LF92, exact original unit |
| 93 | - For ordinary LAU/reference-price classes, allowable financing costs concern acquisition/rehabilitation/improvement, net of exempt financing grants; qualifying rent-default insurance is limited to **EUR 300**. Each property's bonus plus expenses cannot create a negative result. The public-programme/other-dwelling classes have their own expressly narrower expense lists. | Current LF93, exact original unit |
| 95 | For those classes set `base = max(0, gross_rent × (1−bonus_rate) − qualifying_finance_costs − allowed_default_insurance)`, omitting insurance where the selected class does not allow it. Do not additionally deduct IBI, community charges, repairs or State-style depreciation merely because State IRNR would allow such an expense. For genuinely **nonresidential premises**, use the separate art. 32 necessary-expense/depreciation limb: evidenced qualifying finance, property taxes/charges without punitive or lateness components, administration/services, lease/legal costs, repairs/conservation, property insurance, utilities and effective depreciation; improvements are capital cost. The total cannot create a negative result for the property. For an ordinary purchased building, effective annual depreciation is at most **3% of acquisition cost excluding land**, capped by remaining depreciable cost. Allocate land from the actual known amount; if unknown, Bizkaia/Gipuzkoa use each year's cadastral land/building proportions, while Álava uses the acquisition-year cadastral proportions. Do not use the State rule taking the greater of acquisition and cadastral construction value. For movables let with the property,use evidenced effective depreciation capped annually at the **minimum coefficient derived from the local CIT maximum depreciation period**,and by remaining depreciable cost; that coefficient is a maximum for this effective-depreciation test,not a compulsory deduction. Do not apply an automatic State furniture10%. A finite-duration acquired usufruct/use right uses cost divided by its years; a lifetime right uses3%, with the cumulative cost ceiling. Match any part-year allocation to the actual income-producing period. Example: full-yearEU owner, gross12,000, evidenced other deductible costs2,000,purchased building cost100,000 excluding land and adequate unamortised balance: depreciation3,000,base7,000,tax1,330. (B PIT regulation47/2014 arts.37–38; A40/2014 arts.36–37; G33/2014 arts.35–36.) This does not convert the residential rule into a universal property-expense rule. (Local PIT art. 32; B/A/G IRNR art. 24; [Bizkaia FAQ 900007012](https://www.bizkaia.eus/ogasuna/faq/faq_detalle.asp?Idioma=CA&idregistro=900007012).) | Current LF95, exact original unit |
| 97 | For **ordinary work**, qualifying EU/EEA employment expenses include evidenced directly connected mandatory social contributions under local PIT art. 22; the separate resident art. 23 employment bonus is not an expense deduction in this branch. The payer's withholding computation ignores the special EU/EEA expense paragraph, so final liability can be lower than gross withholding. A EUR 20,000 taxable wage, EUR 1,200 qualifying contributions and no treaty exemption gives final tax `(20,000−1,200)×19%=3,572`, versus gross withholding `3,800`, refund `228`. This is the statutory method at current rates; the official Bizkaia work example is historical 2020 and its obsolete State-PIT reference is not the authority for the 2026 expense list. (B/A/G arts. 24, 25, 31.2; local PIT art. 22.) | Current LF97, exact original unit |
| 99 | For **ordinary dividends of a nonresident individual**, current local IRNR art. 14.1(a) incorporates local PIT art. 9.24's **EUR 1,500 annual exemption** for the qualifying art. 34(a)/(b) dividend population. This is the derived application of the current incorporation; it is not State IRNR's abolished old exemption. Keep one annual consumed-cap ledger; do not give EUR 1,500 for every payment or collector. Exclude IIC distributions, cooperative-share interest and the statutory acquired-before/quickly-disposed homogeneous-share cases (two months for the specified quoted shares; one year for unquoted shares). An ordinary qualifying EUR 6,000 dividend with the annual cap unused gives `(6,000−1,500)×19%=855`, before eligible expenses/advances or a treaty cap. The statutory exemptions refer to individuals; do not give a corporate recipient this individual exemption. (B/A/G IRNR 14.1(a); local PIT 9.24 and 34.) | Current LF99, exact original unit |
| 101 | For **ordinary direct interest**, test the EU/qualifying EEA interest exemption, public-debt and registered nonresident-account exemptions before applying 19%. Preserve their statutory conditions and noncooperative-territory exclusions. Dividends are not automatically exempt merely because the recipient is EU-resident; the separate qualifying parent/subsidiary or institutional exemptions need their own facts. (B/A/G art. 14.1(b)/(c)/(e), art. 14.2.) | Current LF101, exact original unit |
| 103 | Where a pension is taxable, annual quota is `8%×min(P,12,000) + 30%×min(max(P−12,000,0),6,700) + 40%×max(P−18,700,0)`. Use the annual pension's average rate on the payment, rather than charging every payment independently through the annual bands. The statutory special diplomatic-work 8% and seasonal-worker 2% routes require their actual categories. (B/A/G art. 25.) | Current LF103, exact original unit |
| 105 | ### Basque property sale computation | Current LF105, exact original unit |
| 107 | Use the local PIT gain provisions incorporated by art. 24, not the State capital-gain Guide's unindexed acquisition cost: | Current LF107, exact original unit |
| 109 | 1. Establish actual acquisition cost plus evidenced acquisition taxes/costs (excluding interest), later qualifying improvements, ownership share and dates. Reduce for required minimum depreciation when applicable. | Current LF109, exact original unit |
| 110 | 2. Apply the **sale year's approved local monetary-update coefficient separately to each cost/improvement component according to its payment year, and separately to depreciation by its year**. Do not multiply only the purchase price if the costs/improvements belong to other years. | Current LF110, exact original unit |
| 111 | 3. Net sale proceeds are the actual consideration subject to the market-value floor, less seller-paid disposal costs/taxes. Gain is those net proceeds minus updated net cost, using the specific local exclusions and any proved relief. For an ordinary taxable disposal apply 19%; do not put the gain into the resident progressive savings scale or offset another separate non-PE disposal loss. | Current LF111, exact original unit |
| 112 | 4. The buyer withholds **3% of agreed gross consideration**, using local Modelo 211 within **one month**. It is an advance, not 3% of the gain. The seller's Modelo 210 credits the actual advance against the final tax and settles the balance/refund; a loss does not dispense with the seller's return needed to recover the advance. The specific qualifying contribution-of-property-to-resident-company exception remains. | Current LF112, exact original unit |
| 114 | Example with **actual Bizkaia 2026/2019 coefficient 1.249**: sale400,000; seller cost1,500; acquisition200,000 plus same-year3,000 costs; no improvements/depreciation/relief. Updated basis253,547; net proceeds398,500; gain144,953; tax27,541.07; buyer advance12,000; seller balance15,541.07. [Bizkaia's current official sale example](https://www.bizkaia.eus/ogasuna/faq/faq_detalle.asp?Idioma=CA&idregistro=900007014) independently confirms the coefficient and arithmetic. (B/A/G IRNR arts. 24–26; local PIT arts. 44–46 and each year's coefficient decree.) | Current LF114, exact original unit |
| 116 | Historic pre-1994/2012 relief, former-main-home/reinvestment and specialist share disposals require their own local transitional/exemption provisions, rather than importing every State historic relief. They are bounded outside this ordinary example; this method does not erase those existing historic limitations. | Current LF116, exact original unit |
| 118 | ### Navarra non-PE computation | Current LF118, exact original unit |
| 120 | Use **State substantive IRNR**, positively continued by N-continuation. The ordinary State method already supplied in the [common-territory IRNR Guide](es-non-resident-income-tax-irnr-and.md#the-base) therefore supplies Navarra's taxable rental base and eligible EU/EEA expenses, operative 2026 imputation rule, unindexed ordinary property gain, 19%/24% rates, pensions, statutory interest/dividend exemptions and 3% property-sale advance. Do not import the new Basque zero-imputation or individual1500 dividend exemption into Navarra. Ordinary own-use Navarra property therefore still needs the actual State imputation base and days/ownership proportion; e.g. a qualifying1.1% case with cadastral100,000,full-year/full-owner and19%rate gives209. The substantive handoff does **not** import State filing deadlines: local OF231/2013 controls those below. | Current LF120, exact original unit |
| 122 | ### Complete2026 non-PE property-gain coefficients | Current LF122, exact original unit |
| 124 | For a disposal accruing in calendar 2026 under the Basque local non-PE IRNR method, use the following **PIT** coefficient table for the acquisition-cost/gain calculation incorporated by IRNR24. Apply each coefficient to the relevant acquisition/improvement/expense amount by its payment year and each depreciation amount by its corresponding year, then subtract updated depreciation from updated eligible cost. Use actual eligible/minimum depreciation under the selected local law. Do not apply one acquisition-year coefficient to later improvement costs or to the entire historical depreciation balance. Local PIT45.2 expressly supplies those separate timing rules. Seller expenses reduce proceeds under PIT45.3; they are not acquisition cost. Preserve applicable pre-1994 transitional relief as a separate subsequent legal test; this table alone does not resolve every historic acquisition. | Current LF124, exact original unit |
| 126 | **Exact date exception in all three decrees:** for an asset acquired **31 December 1994**, use the **1995 coefficient 2.156**, despite the ordinary 1994-and-earlier row being2.030. The later improvement/expense/depreciation-year rules remain separate. | Current LF126, exact original unit |
| 128 | The lookup below applies to 2026 disposals, including a 2026 return filed in2027. A2025 disposal filed in2026 requires the2025 decree instead. Navarra's currently retained State non-PE substantive IRNR method does not acquire Basque indexation merely because Navarra collects the tax. | Current LF128, exact original unit |

| 168 | ### PEs: select one law, calculate one result, then allocate collection | Current LF168, exact original unit |
| 170 | Use CE21→14 and CN28→18 for governing law; use CE22→15 and CN28.2(b)→19 for collector selection. For 2026 the preceding-period operations threshold is **EUR 12 million inclusive** on the domicile route. Annualise a short period and retain the actual startup estimate/reconciliation rules. Above the threshold, allocation follows current-period territorial operations, with the statutory two-decimal percentage; governing-law selection separately uses preceding-period75% tests and applicable fiscal-group exceptions. Apply the [foral-CIT connecting-factor ledger](es-foral-corporate-tax.md#who-this-applies-to) and provincial law-selection rules to the PE; do not infer law from the largest current-year tax payment. A combined Navarra/Basque case still needs the actual agreements applied together, not a four-province shortcut. (CE14–18/21–23; CN18–23/28–30.) | Current LF170, exact original unit |
| 172 | For a **Basque-law ordinary trading PE**, B/A/G arts. 16–19 provide these indispensable changes to the CIT handoff: | Current LF172, exact original unit |
| 174 | - Include all income attributable to that PE, wherever obtained; maintain separate accounts and the actual assets/functions/related transactions. Do not mix unrelated establishments' income or credits. | Current LF174, exact original unit |
| 175 | - Start with the selected province's [ordinary CIT accounting-to-tax method](es-foral-corporate-tax.md#the-base), then apply IRNR18's overrides: add back head-office/other-PE royalties,interest,commissions and the listed assistance/use payments. The foreign-bank interest exception is specific. Deduct a reasonable head-office management/administration allocation only if recorded, accompanied by the required allocation statement and based on rational,consistent factors. No notional head-office equity-capital cost is deductible. | Current LF175, exact original unit |
| 176 | - **Do not apply CIT arts.38,47 or TitleIV ChapterV**, expressly excluded by IRNR18.1(d). In particular, CIT capitalisation/profit-application reserves cannot be copied into a PE return through a blanket link. Apply the actual IRNR loss incorporation to CIT55. | Current LF176, exact original unit |
| 177 | - SME incentives/rate classification require that the **nonresident entity itself** could qualify under CIT13, with the actual group/ownership/size/activity tests; a small local branch of a large foreign company does not become a qualifying microcompany solely from its local receipts. | Current LF177, exact original unit |
| 178 | - IRNR19.1 incorporates CIT56.1's applicable rate: ordinary general24%, eligible micro/small20%, with actual category evidence. Apply the incorporated local credits and CIT59 minimum/credit limits and local advance-payment rules as IRNR19.4 specifies; keep other-PE credits separate. Deduct only attributable actual payments. | Current LF178, exact original unit |
| 180 | For a **Navarra-law PE**, LF26/2016 art.135 applies the State IRNR regime but replaces its CIT references with the Navarra CIT law. Thus use State IRNR18's head-office/equity/expense overrides, Navarra's incorporated ordinary CIT base/loss/rate/credit/minimum method and actual size tests, rather than automatically applying State25%. Navarra's normal rates are28%, conditional25%, eligible small23%/micro19%, with all existing Guide conditions preserved. Use the Navarra instalment/annual return route. A PE selected into State law continues the State method even if part of its collection belongs to a foral treasury. (LF26/2016 arts.51,68,75,135; State IRNR18–23; [Navarra OF36/2026](https://www.lexnavarra.navarra.es/detalle.asp?r=58604) confirms the PE legal/formal framework for its stated2025 return population.) | Current LF180, exact original unit |

Exclude it where19.3's EU-residence or qualifying treaty/reciprocity branch applies. Navarra's continued State19.2 rate is **19%**, subject to its own exclusions. | 281 | ### Basic2026 interest and narrow exceptions | Current LF283, exact original unit |
| 283 | **Ordinary tax default interest is4.0625% annually in all four territories**. “Legal interest”, used where the local law specifically substitutes it, is3.25% for2026. The statutory uplift is25% of legal interest, so3.25%×1.25=4.0625%, not3.25%+25 percentage points. These are interest rates, not new flat penalties on every late return. | Current LF285, exact original unit |

| 292 | A selected law's exception matters. Álava26.6 substitutes legal interest for qualifying fully guaranteed deferral/instalment/suspension and includes any guarantee the administration regards as sufficient; Gipuzkoa26.6 and Navarra50.2(c) enumerate the qualifying full bank/reciprocal-guarantee/caution-insurance guarantees. Do not transfer those exception lists automatically to Bizkaia or to an unsecured debt. Álava's additional compliant-taxpayer interest concession under NF21/2025 art.7 starts **1January2027**; it is not a2026 concession. Retain statutory excluded periods and the existing reviewed procedures. For a debt spanning years, split interest by the actual years/rates and applicable accrual periods; this addendum does not authorise interest where the surcharge rule excludes it. | Current LF294, exact original unit |
| 294 | Illustrative arithmetic, assuming the local law actually requires interest for every stated day and an unchanged principal:10,000 for a whole365-day2026 accrual year produces406.25;73days on a365-day basis produces81.25. A100,000 eligible acquisition on30December1994 updates to203,000, while the same amount acquired31December1994 updates to215,600 before other adjustments or historic relief. | Current LF296, exact original unit |
| 297 | ## Cross-border points | Current LF299, exact original unit |
| 299 | Apply the actual treaty residence,PE and income articles to the evidenced recipient. A treaty cap limits the selected-law tax; it does not establish a different collector or replace local filing rules. Use the common-territory Guide for its supplied residence/departure methods only after establishing the governing law. Historic pre-1994/2012 relief,main-home reinvestment,transparent entities,specialist sectors and unusual PE attribution/elections need their own local provisions and facts. The selected-law calculation and interadministration payment ledgers remain separate under CE21–23 and CN28–30. | Current LF301, exact original unit |
| 301 | ## Two worked examples that recompute | Current LF303, exact original unit |
| 303 | ### Example1: qualifying reference-price dwelling,not an ordinary ungated70% claim | Current LF305, exact original unit |
| 305 | An Italian-resident individual owns the whole Bizkaia dwelling,lets it throughout2026 under a proved qualifying reference-price rent restriction and receives12,000. There are no financing costs or qualifying default-insurance premiums. The70% local bonus leaves3,600;19% gives684. IBI500 and community charges1,200 do not reduce this residential base. No payment on account was made. This follows the current Bizkaia official example's substantive calculation with its missing reference-price condition made explicit; use the separate filing table for timing. | Current LF307, exact original unit |
| 307 | ```oa-check<br>name: Bizkaia2026 EU residential reference-price rental<br>inputs:<br>  gross_rent: 12000<br>  bonus_rate: 0.70<br>  qualifying_finance: 0<br>  allowed_insurance: 0<br>  tax_rate: 0.19<br>  advances: 0<br>steps:<br>  bonus: gross_rent * bonus_rate<br>  base: max(0, gross_rent - bonus - qualifying_finance - allowed_insurance)<br>  tax: base * tax_rate<br>  balance: tax - advances<br>expected:<br>  bonus: 8400<br>  base: 3600<br>  tax: 684<br>  balance: 684<br>``` | Current LF309, exact original unit |
| 328 | ### Example2: Bizkaia indexed property gain and buyer advance | Current LF330, exact original unit |
| 330 | A nonresident sells an ordinary Bizkaia property in2026 for400,000 and pays1,500 disposal costs. The2019 purchase price was200,000 plus3,000 same-year acquisition costs. There is no depreciation,improvement,legacy exemption or treaty exemption. The actual2026coefficient for2019is1.249: updated basis253,547,gain144,953,tax27,541.07. The purchaser's3%advance is12,000; the seller's210balance is15,541.07. Keep cost/improvement/depreciation years separately where they differ; do not generalise1.249 to every purchase year or province. | Current LF332, exact original unit |
| 332 | ```oa-check<br>name: Bizkaia2026 sale with2019 indexed basis and3percent advance<br>inputs:<br>  sale_price: 400000<br>  sale_cost: 1500<br>  acquisition_price: 200000<br>  acquisition_cost: 3000<br>  update_coefficient: 1.249<br>  gain_rate: 0.19<br>  buyer_rate: 0.03<br>steps:<br>  updated_basis: (acquisition_price + acquisition_cost) * update_coefficient<br>  net_proceeds: sale_price - sale_cost<br>  gain: net_proceeds - updated_basis<br>  tax: max(0, gain) * gain_rate<br>  buyer_advance: sale_price * buyer_rate<br>  seller_balance: tax - buyer_advance<br>expected:<br>  updated_basis: 253547<br>  net_proceeds: 398500<br>  gain: 144953<br>  tax: 27541.07<br>  buyer_advance: 12000<br>  seller_balance: 15541.07<br>``` | Current LF334, exact original unit |
| 358 | ## Ask the client first | Current LF360, exact original unit |
| 360 | 1. Where is the recipient treaty-resident,and what current certificate and entitlement evidence supports that? | Current LF362, exact original unit |
| 361 | 2. What actual property,work,service,payer or PE facts select law and collector,and what are the payer's/PE's prior/current territorial percentages? | Current LF363, exact original unit |
| 362 | 3. What income category,accrual,lease/rent restriction,expenses,ownership and acquisition/improvement/depreciation history applies? | Current LF364, exact original unit |
| 363 | 4. What dividends have already consumed the annual exemption,and what holding/disposal or excluded-distribution facts matter? | Current LF365, exact original unit |
| 364 | 5. For a PE,what foreign-entity group/size facts,head-office charges,losses,credits,remittances and actual payments reconcile the result? | Current LF366, exact original unit |
| 365 | 6. What returns,withholding certificates,advance payments,representation and notices establish settlement and correction dates? | Current LF367, exact original unit |
